documents.text: Dear Guest, regarding your upcoming stay, please note that if you cancel before the designated cutoff, the entire payment will be returned to you as money with no deduction. Your booked accommodation features an operational swimming pool on the premises, which is available throughout your stay without any separate fee. However, we must clarify that neither the activity itinerary nor any statement confirming a guided walk is included in the amount quoted. Additionally, there are currently no rules addressing overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary for your arrival. We look forward to welcoming you.

Internal Note: Selected offer is Alder; the distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer. For this booking, arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically without any earlier contact or request. Cancellations made before the cutoff result in the entire payment being returned as money, with no deduction. Be aware that the accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Furthermore, the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary.

Agent Memo: Current selected terms completely replace the old policy. Under these new terms, arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. The old policy stating a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving is now void. Regarding refunds, before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. Note that neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied.

A swimming area is mentioned, but its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated. The amount quoted covers accommodation only, and neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included is supplied. Regarding arrival, two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. One states arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically without earlier contact, while the other states a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. Neither overrides the other, so applicable terms are unresolved.

Travel Agent Notes: The selected stay is 8–15 May. The distractor policy regarding automatic arrival at 01:30 applies exclusively to December stays and is not relevant here. For this May booking, a guest reaching reception at 01:30 cannot check in unless they obtained permission before arriving. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. The amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Additionally, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund for cancellation is documented.

Dear Guest, we are pleased to confirm your booking details. Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction.
